simulationOnly.title: Simulated payments only
simulationOnly.body: Every payment in this environment is fabricated and demo-safe. No funds move, no messages reach any provider, and no real settlement occurs. Do not enter real account, beneficiary, or banking information.

nonBindingQuotes.title: Indicative pricing is non-binding
nonBindingQuotes.body: FX rates and fees shown here are simulated and for demonstration only. Indicative quotes must be refreshed into an executable quote before submission, and no rate shown constitutes a real dealing commitment.

maskedData.title: Some details are masked
maskedData.body: Account numbers, IBANs, BICs, beneficiary names, and remittance text are masked according to the active display policy to protect information. Masked values are demo-safe placeholders and never carry real banking details.

clientSideChecks.title: Checks are simulated client-side
clientSideChecks.body: Validation, compliance, and settlement checks in this demo are simulated deterministically in the browser. They are not server-enforced guarantees and never reflect real screening or routing logic.

OUR.title: OUR — Sender pays all charges
OUR.body: You bear all transaction charges. The beneficiary receives the full instructed amount and no fees are deducted along the correspondent chain.

SHA.title: SHA — Shared charges
SHA.body: You pay your own bank's charges. Any charges levied by the receiving and intermediary banks are borne by the beneficiary and may reduce the amount they receive.

BEN.title: BEN — Beneficiary pays all charges
BEN.body: All transaction charges are deducted from the transfer amount and borne by the beneficiary. The amount received will be lower than the instructed amount.

matched.title: Beneficiary verified
matched.body: The beneficiary account and name-on-account were fully validated and may be used for this payment.

namePartialMatch.title: Confirm beneficiary name
namePartialMatch.body: The account identifiers matched, but the name-on-account is only a close match. Review the beneficiary details and confirm before continuing.

nameMismatch.title: Beneficiary name mismatch
nameMismatch.body: The name-on-account did not match the registered account holder. Correct the beneficiary details and validate again.

ibanInvalid.title: IBAN could not be validated
ibanInvalid.body: The IBAN failed structural or checksum validation. Check the account details and try again.

bicUnknown.title: BIC could not be resolved
bicUnknown.body: The BIC/SWIFT code could not be matched to a known institution. Verify the routing details and try again.

accountNotFound.title: Account not found
accountNotFound.body: No account could be located for the supplied identifiers. Confirm the beneficiary details with the payee.

serviceUnavailable.title: Validation unavailable
serviceUnavailable.body: The beneficiary validation service is temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment and try validating again.

eligible.title: Currency pair supported
eligible.body: This currency pair is fully supported and may be selected for international payment initiation.

sameCurrency.title: Same currency selected
sameCurrency.body: The source and beneficiary currencies are identical, so no cross-currency conversion applies. Choose two different currencies to initiate an international payment.

unsupported.title: Currency pair not supported
unsupported.body: This currency pair is not supported for international payment initiation in this demo. Choose a supported combination to continue.

restrictedCorridor.title: Restricted corridor
restrictedCorridor.body: This corridor is restricted for compliance reasons and cannot be used in this demo. Select a different beneficiary currency.

temporarilyUnavailable.title: Pricing temporarily unavailable
temporarilyUnavailable.body: Pricing for this pair is temporarily unavailable, so selection is blocked until it is restored. Wait a moment and try again.

active.title: Quote active
active.body: This quote is valid and may be used according to its classification until it expires.

expiringSoon.title: Quote expiring soon
expiringSoon.body: This quote is about to expire. Refresh it before submission to secure a current rate.

expired.title: Quote expired
expired.body: This quote has expired and can no longer be used. Request a fresh quote to continue.

requoteRequired.title: Re-quote required
requoteRequired.body: This is an indicative, display-only rate. Convert it to an executable quote before submitting the payment.

unavailable.title: Pricing unavailable
unavailable.body: Pricing for this pair is temporarily unavailable and no quote could be produced. Wait a moment and try again.

fieldRequired.title: Required field missing
fieldRequired.body: A mandatory or conditionally-required field is missing. Complete the highlighted field before continuing.

fieldForbidden.title: Field not permitted
fieldForbidden.body: A field is present that is not permitted under the active rule set. Remove it to continue.

fieldTooLong.title: Field too long
fieldTooLong.body: A field exceeds its maximum permitted length. Shorten the highlighted field to continue.

fieldTooShort.title: Field too short
fieldTooShort.body: A field is shorter than its minimum permitted length. Provide a longer value to continue.

invalidCharacters.title: Invalid characters
invalidCharacters.body: A field contains characters outside the permitted character set. Remove the unsupported characters and try again.

invalidFormat.title: Invalid format
invalidFormat.body: A field does not match its required ISO code or structural format. Correct the value and try again.

structuredAddressRequired.title: Structured address required
structuredAddressRequired.body: A structured address is required and unstructured free-text is not permitted under the active rule set. Supply the discrete address elements.

hybridAddressNotPermitted.title: Hybrid address not permitted
hybridAddressNotPermitted.body: A hybrid address is not permitted under the active rule set. Provide either a fully structured or an unstructured address as required.

accepted.title: Payment accepted
accepted.body: All processing checks passed and this payment has been accepted for settlement.

fraudReview.title: Held for fraud review
fraudReview.body: This payment has been flagged for manual fraud review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

amlReview.title: Held for AML review
amlReview.body: This payment has been flagged for manual anti-money-laundering review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

sanctionsReview.title: Held for sanctions review
sanctionsReview.body: This payment has been flagged for manual sanctions review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

repairBeneficiary.title: Beneficiary details need repair
repairBeneficiary.body: The beneficiary details require correction before this payment can be reprocessed. Repair the details and resubmit.

repairRemittance.title: Remittance info needs repair
repairRemittance.body: The remittance information is incomplete or malformed and must be repaired before this payment can be reprocessed.

unavailable.title: Processing unavailable
unavailable.body: The processing service is temporarily unavailable and produced no result. Wait a moment and try processing again.

fundsInsufficient.title: Insufficient funds
fundsInsufficient.body: The source account did not hold sufficient available balance for this payment. Review the account balance and resubmit if appropriate.

sanctionsRejected.title: Payment rejected
sanctionsRejected.body: This payment could not be released following sanctions screening and has been rejected. No funds were moved.

transmitted.title: Message transmitted
transmitted.body: The message was transmitted to the simulated SWIFT network and is awaiting acknowledgement.

acknowledged.title: Message acknowledged
acknowledged.body: The simulated SWIFT network acknowledged this message and accepted it for onward delivery.

repairBeneficiary.title: Beneficiary details need repair
repairBeneficiary.body: The message was returned for repair because the beneficiary details require correction. Repair the details and retransmit.

repairCorrespondent.title: Correspondent details need repair
repairCorrespondent.body: The message was returned for repair because the correspondent or routing details require correction. Repair the routing and retransmit.

unavailable.title: Network unavailable
unavailable.body: The simulated SWIFT network is temporarily unavailable and produced no result. Wait a moment and try transmitting again.

nakFormat.title: Message rejected
nakFormat.body: The simulated network rejected this message because it failed format validation. No funds were moved — correct the message and retransmit.

nakField.title: Message rejected
nakField.body: The simulated network rejected this message because a mandatory field was missing or malformed. No funds were moved — correct the field and retransmit.

signed.title: Signature confirmed
signed.body: The signer completed the eSign ceremony. This payment is now approved and ready for release.

expired.title: Signature request expired
expired.body: The eSign request lapsed before it was completed. You can resend a fresh signature request to the signer.

unavailable.title: eSign provider unavailable
unavailable.body: The eSign provider is temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment and try requesting the signature again.

transientError.title: Something went wrong
transientError.body: A transient error interrupted the signature ceremony. No changes were made — please retry the request.

declined.title: Signature declined
declined.body: The signer declined to sign this payment. Review the payment details and, if appropriate, submit a new approval request.

pendingApproval.title: Pending approval
pendingApproval.body: This payment has been submitted and is awaiting approval before release.

accepted.title: Accepted
accepted.body: This payment was approved and accepted for processing.

processing.title: Processing
processing.body: This payment is progressing through simulated compliance and settlement checks.

pendingReview.title: Pending review
pendingReview.body: A check raised a concern; this payment is held pending an operator decision.

repairRequired.title: Repair required
repairRequired.body: A correctable data issue was found; this payment must be repaired and resubmitted.

sentToSwift.title: Sent to SWIFT
sentToSwift.body: The payment message has been transmitted to the simulated SWIFT network and awaits acknowledgement.

acknowledged.title: Acknowledged
acknowledged.body: The simulated SWIFT network acknowledged the message and accepted it for onward delivery.

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.body: A blocking check or acknowledgement failure rejected this payment. No funds were moved.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: An unexpected error interrupted this action. No changes were saved — please try again.

aborted.title: Action cancelled
aborted.body: The request was cancelled before it completed. No changes were made — you can start again when ready.

storageUnavailable.title: Storage unavailable
storageUnavailable.body: Browser storage is disabled or full, so this demo is running from temporary in-memory data. Your changes will not persist across reloads.

loading.title: Loading
loading.body: Please wait while the requested payment information is prepared.

empty.title: Nothing to display
empty.body: There are no payments to show for the current view. Actions taken in this demo will appear here.

retryable.title: You can retry
retryable.body: This action did not complete but can be retried safely. No changes were made — try again when ready.

notRetryable.title: This action cannot be retried
notRetryable.body: This outcome is final and cannot be retried. Review the details and, if appropriate, start a new request.

limitReached.title: Retry limit reached
limitReached.body: You have used all available retry attempts for this action in the demo. This limit is enforced client-side only and is not a server guarantee.
